name: Jisel Olfiria
original_name: ジセル・オルフィーリア
source: 38 years old in Earth years. Queen of the planet Orpheus of the Olfiria dynasty. Like Naotaro, she is a "projectionist", so she was captured alive and forced to be projected into an "Orga Card". Her husband, the king, was killed, and her only son, the prince, is currently missing.
translation: 38 years old in Earth years. Queen of the planet Orpheus of the Olfiria dynasty. Like Naotaro, she is a "projectionist", so she was captured alive and forced to be projected into an "Orga Card". Her husband, the king, was killed, and her only son, the prince, is currently missing.
